chunks.heading: Use cases of ANI: tools and jobs, box by box
chunks.explanation_md:
The **Use Cases of ANI** infographic has five boxes. They carry the same five domain names as the ANI market table.

- **General AI market (cross-domain ANI's):** GPT-4, Gemini, Claude, IBM Watson. Uses: conversational AI, email campaigns, SEO optimization, language assistants, coding assistants.
- **Marketing & text AI:** Grammarly, ChatGPT, Jasper AI, Google Translate. Uses: content creation, email campaigns, SEO optimization, language translation, text summarization.
- **Enterprise & predictive analytics AI:** IBM Watson, Salesforce Einstein, Zest AI. Uses: **fraud detection, demand forecasting, churn prediction, predictive maintenance, financial risk scoring**.
- **AI agents / chatbots:** Alexa, Siri, Google Assistant, Intercom, Drift. Uses: virtual customer support, voice-controlled devices, appointment scheduling, internal IT bots, retail shopping assistants.
- **Big data + AI platforms:** Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI. Uses: data lake AI pipelines, real-time analytics, customer segmentation, sentiment analysis.

Note: this box files GPT-4, Gemini and IBM Watson under **ANI** (cross-domain ANI's), while the AGI slide uses them as **AGI** examples.
chunks.exam_line: Five ANI use-case boxes: general AI market (GPT-4, Gemini, Claude, IBM Watson), marketing & text AI (Grammarly, Jasper AI), enterprise & predictive analytics (Salesforce Einstein, Zest AI), AI agents / chatbots (Alexa, Siri, Intercom, Drift), big data + AI platforms (Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI).

chunks.heading: ANI in business: retail, healthcare and BFSI
chunks.explanation_md:
The **ANI in Business** table looks at three sectors:

| | Retail | Healthcare | BFSI |
|---|---|---|---|
| Types of ANI | recommendation engines, dynamic pricing, inventory management | diagnostic image analysis, predictive risk modeling, fraud detection | fraud detection, credit scoring, AI chatbots |
| Users / economics | personalized experiences | improved accuracy | faster service response |
| Market | rapid market growth | **$29 billion in 2024** | **$26.2 billion in 2024** |

The second picture, **ANI in Healthcare**, shows four uses: **medical imaging, drug discovery, diagnosis and patient monitoring**.

Notice that **fraud detection** turns up in both healthcare and BFSI.

questions.stem: The deck places GPT-4, Gemini and IBM Watson under two different types of AI. Explain, quoting each slide's own wording.
questions.model_answer_md:
The same tools appear in two places in the deck with different labels.

- **Use Cases of ANI infographic:** GPT-4, Gemini, Claude and IBM Watson sit in the box **'General AI Market (cross-domain ANI's)'**, used for conversational AI, email campaigns, SEO optimization, language and coding assistants. Here they count as **ANI**.
- **'Strong AI' (AGI) slide:** **OpenAI GPT-4 / GPT-3 / Gemini** (research, tutoring, coding) and **IBM Watson** (medical records, logistics) are given as **real-world examples of AGI**, with the line *'We are halfway to AGI'*.

In an answer, name the slide: on the use-cases slide they are cross-domain ANI, on the AGI slide they are early AGI examples.

rubric.point: Use-cases slide: 'cross-domain ANI's' box with GPT-4, Gemini, Claude, IBM Watson
Their listed uses: conversational AI, email campaigns, SEO, language and coding assistants

questions.stem: A retailer, a hospital and a bank each want to adopt ANI. Using the ANI in Business table, explain the types of ANI, the benefit and the market figure for each sector.
questions.model_answer_md:
The **ANI in Business** table shows that each sector uses different narrow AI tools for its own goal. Applying it to the three firms:

| | Retail | Healthcare | BFSI |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Types of ANI** | recommendation engines, dynamic pricing, inventory management | diagnostic image analysis, predictive risk modeling, fraud detection | fraud detection, credit scoring, AI chatbots |
| **Benefit** | personalized experiences | improved accuracy | faster service response |
| **Market** | rapid market growth | $29 billion in 2024 | $26.2 billion in 2024 |

**The retailer** should look at **recommendation engines** to suggest products, **dynamic pricing** to set prices and **inventory management** to keep stock right. The payoff is **personalized experiences** for customers, in a sector the table marks for **rapid market growth**.

**The hospital** can use **diagnostic image analysis**, **predictive risk modeling** and **fraud detection**. The benefit is **improved accuracy**. The **ANI in Healthcare** picture adds four uses: **medical imaging, drug discovery, diagnosis and patient monitoring**. Healthcare ANI was worth **$29 billion in 2024**.

**The bank (BFSI)** can use **fraud detection**, **credit scoring** and **AI chatbots**. The benefit is **faster service response**, and the market was **$26.2 billion in 2024**.

**A point to notice:** **fraud detection** appears in both healthcare and BFSI, so one kind of ANI can serve more than one sector.

In short, each firm should pick the narrow tools that match its own goal: personalization for retail, accuracy for healthcare and speed of service for banking.

rubric.point: Retail: recommendation engines, dynamic pricing, inventory management; personalized experiences
Healthcare: diagnostic image analysis, predictive risk modeling, fraud detection; improved accuracy
BFSI: fraud detection, credit scoring, AI chatbots; faster service response
Markets: retail rapid growth, healthcare $29 billion, BFSI $26.2 billion (2024)
ANI in Healthcare: medical imaging, drug discovery, diagnosis, patient monitoring
Fraud detection appears in both healthcare and BFSI

questions.stem: Describe the five boxes of the Use Cases of ANI infographic, giving the tools and uses in each.
questions.model_answer_md:
The **Use Cases of ANI** infographic shows where narrow AI is put to work. Its five boxes carry the same names as the domains in the ANI market table.

**1. General AI market (cross-domain ANI's)**
- Tools: GPT-4, Gemini, Claude, IBM Watson.
- Uses: conversational AI, email campaigns, SEO optimization, language assistants, coding assistants.

**2. Marketing & text AI**
- Tools: Grammarly, ChatGPT, Jasper AI, Google Translate.
- Uses: content creation, email campaigns, SEO optimization, language translation, text summarization.

**3. Enterprise & predictive analytics AI**
- Tools: IBM Watson, Salesforce Einstein, Zest AI.
- Uses: **fraud detection, demand forecasting, churn prediction, predictive maintenance, financial risk scoring**.

**4. AI agents / chatbots**
- Tools: Alexa, Siri, Google Assistant, Intercom, Drift.

**5. Big data + AI platforms**
